changelog: 🚀 Phase 10 Upgrade: Native Memory-Mapped Chat Cache & Zero-Copy Transcript Splicing Engine in Rust.
⚡ Zero-Copy Log Offsets: High-throughput `memmap2` and SIMD `memchr` newline indexing eliminates multi-megabyte GC pressure during long conversation loads.
🧬 Instant Turn Splicing: Automatic zero-allocation splicing of truncated conversation turns between compact transcript and full log files via JNI and Rust daemon endpoints.
